title: Ring Unlock Puzzle
description: Rotate interlocking slotted C-rings to line up gaps and slide every metal hoop cleanly free—a tactile mechanical puzzle straight off Douyin feeds.
controls: Drag to rotate any slotted ring until its gap lines up cleanly to slip off interlocking hoops.

zh-CN.title: 解锁圆环
zh-CN.description: 抖音刷屏机械解谜解锁圆环：旋转带缺口的彩色圆环找准角度逐一脱扣解开，宛如把玩真实鲁班锁超上瘾！
zh-CN.controls: 按住旋转带缺口的圆环对准缝隙，逐个将互相嵌套的圆环全部拆解分离。
